task: F008 Like Kudos — turn the static heart+count on KudosCard into a client-side like toggle (optimistic UI, cannot like your own post), without redesigning the card/compose form/board layout. Persistence mechanism revised mid-session — see acceptanceCriteria FR-3 and clarifications.md.
acceptanceCriteria: FR-1: clicking the heart on a Kudos card (highlight or feed variant) toggles the liked state for that card
FR-2: displayed heart count is post.hearts plus 1 when liked by the current user, updated in the same render as the click
FR-3: liked state is session-only React state owned by KudosPageClient, lost on page refresh, mirroring the F007 posts precedent
FR-4: a post authored by the current user (sender.name === currentUser.name) cannot be liked — heart renders disabled
FR-5: the toggle is idempotent per click with no separate pending/loading state (no network call)
FR-6: the liked heart reuses the existing #FFEA9E accent color, no new design token
Backward compatible: KudosCard with no like props renders the original static span heart unchanged
Zero regressions in pre-existing F006/F007 kudos test suites caused by this change
blastRadius: Kudos live board (/kudos) only. Additive optional props on KudosCard/AllKudosFeed/HighlightKudosCarousel — no existing prop removed or made required except KudosBoardProps.currentUser/likedIds/onToggleLike (new required props, already supplied by the sole caller KudosPageClient). No change to KudosPost's shape (only its hearts doc comment). No backend, no route change.
contracts: KudosCardProps gains optional liked/canLike/onToggleLike — canLike undefined renders the pre-existing static span (byte-identical DOM), preserving every caller that does not opt in
KudosCardLabels gains required like/unlike i18n strings (aria-label source) — every existing caller updated (dictionaries, tests)
KudosBoardProps gains required currentUser/likedIds/onToggleLike, supplied by KudosPageClient which already owned currentUser since F007
canLikeKudos(post, currentUser) pure selector added to kudos-selectors.ts, no existing export changed
likedIds: Set<string> is session-only React state (useState) owned by KudosPageClient, prop-drilled through KudosBoard to both card surfaces
